# Session notes, 25 July

Bob arrived on time and looked tired. He opened by saying the week had been hard,
starting with Monday's performance review, and that he had spent most of Monday
evening replaying it.

We spent the first half of the session on the replaying itself. He was able to
name it as rumination without prompting, which is new. When I asked what the
replaying was trying to protect him from, he said something about being caught
out, and then went quiet for a while.

Thought records: he completed two during the week. The second one shifted
something. He noticed that nobody had actually commented on his performance, and
reported the tightness in his chest easing as he wrote it down.

Risk: no change from last session. He denied any thoughts of harming himself when
asked directly. Protective factors unchanged, his partner and the dog.

Plan for next week is to keep the thought records going, moved to his desk rather
than the evening, and to add a short wind down before bed, since the waking
around three is still there.
